description:
Use this when the user wants summaries of several filings of one Indian company at once (up to 10 news_ids from get_stock_events). It may queue processing and use allowance.

Returns one entry per distinct filing, in the order asked: the extracted facts with quotes, or a status such as `pending`, `not_queued`, `failed` or `skipped` with the reason. `news_ids` takes up to 10 filings of the same company. Filings not yet extracted are queued, each counting against the daily allowance, and the call never waits: it lists the ones it can be asked for again in `pending_news_ids` with one `retry_after_seconds`. Call again with just those. A large filing may come back as a stub listed in `omitted_for_size`; read it with get_filing_extract.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
